claim_boundary: SOFR relative to the applicable Federal Reserve reserve-remuneration rate is a direct overnight Treasury-repo funding-price relation. Official Federal Reserve material supports monitoring repo-rate spreads to IORB for reserve and money-market pressure, while external crypto research supports only a broad funding-liquidity-to-volatility transmission prior. Neither source establishes that a strictly positive SOFR-policy spread predicts BTC returns or improves a 100/50 passive-core policy.

primary_sources.title: Secured Overnight Financing Rate
primary_sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED / Federal Reserve Bank of New York
primary_sources.use: Official SOFR series identity and transaction-based Treasury-repurchase-market definition.
primary_sources.transfer_boundary: A transaction-based overnight funding rate does not by itself imply a tradable BTC direction.

primary_sources.title: Interest on Reserve Balances Frequently Asked Questions
primary_sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
primary_sources.use: Official IORB policy-rate identity and monetary-policy implementation role.
primary_sources.transfer_boundary: IORB is an administered rate, not a crypto risk-state threshold.

primary_sources.title: Market-Based Indicators on the Road to Ample Reserves
primary_sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
primary_sources.use: Official evidence that SOFR and other money-market spreads to IORB are monitored as reserve-supply and funding-pressure indicators.
primary_sources.transfer_boundary: The note studies reserve conditions and temporary money-market pressures; it does not test BTC returns, the strict-zero relation or a 50-percent exposure rule.

primary_sources.title: Funding liquidity shocks and cryptocurrency returns
primary_sources.use: Peer-reviewed external prior that funding-liquidity shocks can carry information for cryptocurrency volatility and risk management.
primary_sources.transfer_boundary: The paper does not establish this exact SOFR-minus-IOER-or-IORB state, publication lag, BTC spot direction, exposure weight or future performance.

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_nfci_and_stlfsi4: NFCI and STLFSI4 are broad composites of many financial variables. This factor is one directly observed secured overnight funding-price spread with an official policy-rate denominator and no principal-component or percentile construction.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_fed_balance_tga_res: Those families use balance-sheet quantities or their changes. This family uses the price of secured overnight funding relative to the applicable reserve-remuneration rate and cannot add a quantity trend.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_real_yield_treasury: Those families use yield direction, real yields or exchange-value volatility. This family uses a same-day repo-policy spread and cannot add rate direction, dollar direction or volatility.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_crypto_funding_and_: Perpetual funding and futures basis measure crypto leverage and carry. SOFR-policy spread measures U.S. dollar repo funding pressure and cannot reopen, rename or combine the closed crypto funding-carry families.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.prohibited_rescue: Do not add a magnitude threshold, percentile, rolling z-score, smoothing, direction inversion, policy-rate change, reserve quantity, VIX, NFCI, crypto funding, basis, alternate splice date, lag scan or alternate BTC weight after factor or outcome access.

adversarial_prior: SOFR normally trades below IORB, so strictly positive spreads may be too rare outside isolated quarter-end or stress episodes for independent Design and Validation support.
The 2019 repo-market disruption and 2020 pandemic can dominate any apparent state, creating event and year concentration rather than a general mechanism.
Higher funding pressure can coincide with both forced risk reduction and policy-liquidity responses; a directional BTC effect is not identified by the spread alone.
Present-vintage FRED history does not prove original publication-time vintages or revision-free point-in-time availability.
A 50-percent risk reduction can lower drawdown mechanically while surrendering too much BTC upside; matched-capital Calmar, upside and annual breadth must all pass.

Stop DATA_REJECT before hypothesis or BTC outcome access unless both Design and Validation pass every frozen positive-state, nonpositive-state, transition, year-support and concentration gate.

If and only if the source gate passes twice byte-identically, freeze one hypothesis and one direct matched-capital economic manifest before joining BTC outcomes; no threshold, lag, direction or weight variants are allowed.
Stop NO_CANDIDATE if either Design or Validation fails total-PnL, drawdown, Calmar, upside, annual-breadth, holding, terminal-inventory or episode-concentration gates.
Do not open post-2024 outcomes. Any historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires separately sealed independent OOS.
